judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` using `ajv` with `WeakMap` caching and safe error formatting, closely matching the reference implementation's approach. However, the agent stopped mid-way through its own plan, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and omitting roughly half of the ticket's acceptance criteria. Specifically, it is missing the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, as well as the required one-line doc comment on `ToolRegistry.execute` and the full changelog description. Additionally, most of the required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema changes, static compile count, unknown tool throw) and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were not written, and several statements in `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` lack `validated by` links.
